name: build-standard-v3
description: Build Standard v3: goal-driven building with a plain-English plan, a run log and per-step work orders kept in a build-plan folder.

interface.shortDescription: Set a measurable goal, then build to it
interface.longDescription: Version 3 of the Unified Build Standard. Start from a measurable goal with limits and stop conditions, choose a Gated run (report after each phase) or an Unattended run (work until the goal is met), and keep a plain-English plan, a run log and per-step work orders in a build-plan folder so a cheaper model can execute what a stronger model planned.
defaultPrompt: Use build standard v3. My goal is ...
Use build standard v3 in Gated mode.
Use build standard v3 and run unattended.
